description: Implementation of QuicStreamSequencer class handling stream frame processing, buffering, and stream closure logic within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicStreamSequencer
classes.description: Handles sequencing, buffering, and processing of stream frames in QUIC.

methods.name: OnStreamFrame
methods.description: Processes incoming stream frames, updates buffer, and handles stream closure.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrame
methods.description: Processes incoming crypto frames.

methods.name: OnFrameData
methods.description: Handles raw frame data, updates buffer, and triggers stream notifications.

methods.name: CloseStreamAtOffset
methods.description: Marks the stream as closed at a specific offset, validating the offset.

methods.name: MaybeCloseStream
methods.description: Closes the stream if conditions are met, notifying the stream.

methods.name: GetReadableRegions
methods.description: Retrieves readable data regions.

methods.name: GetReadableRegion
methods.description: Retrieves a single readable data region.

methods.name: PeekRegion
methods.description: Peeks at a specific data region without consuming it.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads all available data into a string.

methods.name: Readv
methods.description: Reads data into provided buffers.

methods.name: HasBytesToRead
methods.description: Checks if there are bytes available to read.

methods.name: ReadableBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the stream is closed.

methods.name: MarkConsumed
methods.description: Marks a number of bytes as consumed.

methods.name: SetBlockedUntilFlush
methods.description: Blocks the sequencer until flush.

methods.name: SetUnblocked
methods.description: Unblocks the sequencer and notifies the stream if data is available.

methods.name: StopReading
methods.description: Stops reading and discards buffered data.

methods.name: ReleaseBuffer
methods.description: Releases the entire buffer.

methods.name: ReleaseBufferIfEmpty
methods.description: Releases buffer if it is empty.

methods.name: FlushBufferedFrames
methods.description: Flushes buffered frames and updates stream.

methods.name: NumBytesBuffered
methods.description: Returns number of buffered bytes.

methods.name: NumBytesConsumed
methods.description: Returns number of consumed bytes.

methods.name: IsAllDataAvailable
methods.description: Checks if all data has been received.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representing the internal state.
